results.name: correlated_subquery_salary_comparison

results.name: unindexed_computed_expression_aggregation
results.anti_pattern: Heavy unindexed computed arithmetic join with multi-level grouping
results.original_query: SELECT oi.product_id,        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS total_distinct_orders,        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold,        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_sales_value,        ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) >= 150.0   AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY oi.product_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 5000.0 ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC LIMIT 25;
results.optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, oi.order_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price,
           (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
      AND (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) >= 150.0
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_distinct_orders,
           SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold,
           ROUND(SUM(line_total), 2) AS total_sales_value,
           ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM filtered_items
    GROUP BY product_id
    HAVING SUM(line_total) > 5000.0
)
SELECT product_id, total_distinct_orders, total_units_sold, total_sales_value, avg_unit_price
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC
LIMIT 25;
applied_techniques: CTE decomposition to separate filtering, aggregation, and final selection
Pre-computed line_total in CTE to avoid repeated multiplication
SARGable predicate: moved status filter before computation, though computation remains non-sargable but unavoidable
Reduced temporary B-tree operations by using CTEs to simplify the query plan
Preserved exact output columns and aliases
results.verification_message: Result sets match perfectly as multiset (25 rows).
